description: The AI catalogue NPDev ships: providers (how to reach a server), models (facts per model), profiles (provider + model + effort, ready to use) and bindings (which profiles a feature uses). Schema: schemas/ai/ai-config.schema.json; loader: NPDevCli/npdev_ai_config.py, which layers the user's ~/.config/NPDev/ai.json on top (mine wins, field by field). No key ever appears here -- keys live in the OS store (`npdev providers`). kind: local = runs on this machine, free = hosted free tier, paid = billed; owner decision 2026-10-19: no paid spend by default. A fact NPDev cannot vouch for (a price, an effort level) is left out, never guessed: an unknown price counts as paid, and an empty effortLevels means no effort parameter is ever sent. Prices are USD per million tokens. appVendor marks the providers a generated app may call: external-ai-http builds its vendor profiles from this file (bundled into its jar), driven by each provider's protocol.

protocols.description: POST {baseUrl}/chat/completions, OpenAI chat-completions shape. Effort -> reasoning_effort.
POST {baseUrl}/messages, Anthropic Messages API (x-api-key + anthropic-version). Effort -> output_config.effort; temperature is never sent.

providers.name: Google Gemini (AI Studio free tier)
providers.notes: Daily quota is small and 429/503 are common under load. Developer tools use Gemini's OpenAI-compatible endpoint; generated apps call the native API with the same key.

providers.name: NVIDIA API catalog (free developer tier)
providers.notes: Many models listed by /models answer 404 for a given account; probe before using one.

providers.name: Groq (free tier)
providers.notes: Very fast; tight per-minute token limits.

providers.name: Cerebras Inference (free tier)
providers.notes: Model names change; use `npdev ai models refresh cerebras`.

providers.name: OpenRouter (':free' models only)
providers.notes: ONLY model ids ending ':free' are free; any other model id on this endpoint is billed and is refused without a paid opt-in.

providers.name: Mistral La Plateforme (free Experiment tier)
providers.notes: Free only while the workspace is on the Experiment plan; make sure no billing is attached.

providers.name: Ollama (local)
providers.notes: No key. CPU-only machines are very slow (a 3B model took ~50 min per bench prompt).

providers.name: Anthropic (paid)
providers.notes: Billed. Refused without a paid opt-in.

providers.name: OpenAI (paid)
providers.notes: Billed. Refused without a paid opt-in. NPDev ships no model facts for it: run `npdev ai models refresh openai`.

providers.name: DeepSeek (paid)
providers.notes: Billed. Refused without a paid opt-in. Keys can only be revoked in the console (no key-management API). NPDev ships no model facts for it: run `npdev ai models refresh deepseek`.

models.name: Claude Opus 5.5
models.notes: Thinking cannot be disabled; effort defaults to medium on this model.

models.name: Claude Haiku 5.5
models.notes: Price is for prompts up to 100K tokens ($0.50 / $2.50 beyond).

profiles.name: fast-alt
profiles.description: Second free provider for fast work.

profiles.name: deep
profiles.description: The strongest free model, for harder work.

profiles.name: offline
profiles.description: Local Ollama, no network, no key.

profiles.name: claude
profiles.description: Anthropic, paid: needs a paid opt-in for the feature that uses it.
